GET /api.description: Serves up a json representation of all the available endpoints of the api.

GET.description: Returns a list of users sorted and filtered by queries (limit of 60).

POST.description: Posts a new user to the user collection from a provided data object that contains the required keys (and which are valid) (extra valid keys may also be provided).

GET.description: Returns a user by their mongodb _id.

PATCH.description: Patches/Updates a user by their mongodb _id from a provided data object containing valid keys that exist on the user class.

DELETE.description: Deletes a user by their mongodb _id from the users collection.
